problem.title: Maximum Side Length of Square With Sum Less Than Threshold
problem.problemStatement: Given an N × M matrix of non-negative integers and an integer Threshold, determine the side length of the largest square submatrix whose sum is less than or equal to Threshold.
problem.input: • First line contains N, M, and Threshold. • Next N lines each contain M non-negative integers.
